findings.title: Docker Compose uses default network bridge
findings.description: Services share default bridge network; prefer named networks with explicit isolation.
findings.remediation: Add named networks to docker-compose.yml for service isolation

findings.title: No log redaction middleware for PII in request bodies
findings.description: Logging interceptor may log request bodies containing emails/passwords in debug mode.
findings.remediation: Log only in non-debug mode; sensitive fields (password, token) are already excluded

findings.title: No SBOM attestation in CI pipeline
findings.description: SBOM generated manually; recommend Syft/Grype in CI for automated attestation.
findings.remediation: Add syft/grype step to CI pipeline after Docker build
